purpose: The install-tree identity rendered into README.md for the 0.0.49 candidate. The artefacts were rebuilt from the frozen source by the canonical recipe; this receipt binds the rendered identity to the bytes that build actually produced.

source_identity.measured_source_commit_subject: docs: release row names 0.0.48 with its registry checksum and build hashes
source_identity.build_source_tree_digest_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON of sorted [relpath, size, sha256] for src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs (forensics/tools/phase7_courts.py::_source_tree_digest)
source_identity.release_tree_digest_rule: same rule and same enumeration, computed over the 0.0.49 packaging tree (the working tree's src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs).
source_identity.release_tree_digest_note: The version bump is NOT committed when this build runs. `measured_source_commit` therefore names HEAD (a13b59b6c) only, and the tree digest is the identity of what was actually built. Recompute this digest after the orchestrator commits; the committed release commit must carry the same src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and build.rs bytes for these artefact hashes to remain bound.
source_identity.working_tree_at_build: dirty by design: Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock at 0.0.49, the regenerated documentation blocks, the campaign-status counter and this receipt. No src/ change accompanies the bump, so the source tree differs from 0.0.48 only in the Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock version strings.

build.wall_seconds_note: the initial full build in this batch was not instrumented; this is the timed incremental re-run of the same recipe, which reproduced the same bytes and re-ran all 11 Phase-2 courts. The 0.0.48 receipt recorded 23 s for its clean-ish rebuild.
build.why_rebuilt: the receipt must carry artefact hashes produced by an actual build of the frozen source; the committed artefacts were bound to 0.0.48 and the version bump changes the crate metadata those bytes were built with.

crate_package.why_allow_dirty: the release commit is made by the orchestrator after this prep step, so the 0.0.49 bump and regenerated docs are uncommitted when the package is built.
crate_package.verify_build: cargo package verification build of the unpacked 0.0.49 package succeeded (dev profile, 16.39 s)
crate_package.note: the crate ships source and documentation only; these artefact hashes describe the repository install, not the crate payload.

evidence_carried_forward.closure: the applied closure is not re-measured at this candidate; this receipt binds build identity only.
evidence_carried_forward.why: re-running the safety closure is a deliberate verification activity, not part of packaging.
evidence_carried_forward.safe_compatible: not adjudicated by this receipt; the campaign counter records the principal's OpenSSH graduation at b85c, not a re-measurement here
evidence_carried_forward.mechanism_discharges: none claimed here; the ledger at measured_source_commit is the authority.

non_claims: No obligation is discharged by this receipt, and none is discharged by rebuilding.
The closure and downstream evidence are not re-measured at 0.0.49.
Passing the Phase 2 courts is an ABI/install-layout result, not a safety or cryptographic result.
The export counts are unchanged from 0.0.48 (libcrypto 5906, libssl 608); the artefact bytes differ because the version metadata differs, which is not a regression and not a safety result.
The recorded source identity is HEAD plus a tree digest; the version bump was uncommitted at build time.
